newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-DUGARRY DENIES THREAT TO LEAVE MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DUGARRY DENIES THREAT TO LEAVE MILAN.

text.p: French striker Christophe Dugarry on Monday denied press reports he had threatened to quit AC Milan if he was not included in the starting line-up more frequently with the Italian champions.

"It is true that I mentioned the possibility of leaving Milan but I never threatened to go. I just said I had the World Cup in mind and I wanted to keep my place in the French national team at all costs," he said.
"The World Cup is next year and it is true that if I'm not a first choice player for my club, I don't have a lot of chances to be one for my country."

Dugarry, who was sent off in Milan's 1-0 defeat by Perugia on Sunday, added: "The press played it up but I have respect for Milan and I am very aware that a big team like Milan cannot give me any guarantees to play."
